extra_vocab.en: a small place where people go to see a doctor or get medical care
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於醫療、員工福利與預約情境，例如牙科診所、公司內的健康診所、診所看診時間。

example.en: The city plans to build three new clinics in rural areas.
example.zh: 市政府計畫在鄉村地區蓋三間新診所。

example.en: The dental clinic is on the second floor of the building.
example.zh: 牙科診所在這棟大樓的二樓。

example.en: A free health clinic opened near the factory last month.
example.zh: 上個月工廠附近開了一間免費的健康診所。

example.en: Clinic hours are listed on the door and on our website.
example.zh: 門診時間貼在門上，也列在我們的網站上。

example.en: You should visit a clinic if the pain does not go away.
example.zh: 如果疼痛沒有消失，你應該去診所看看。

examples.en: The clinic is open from nine to five on weekdays.
examples.zh: 這間診所平日從九點開到五點。

examples.en: Our company runs a small clinic for employees on site.
examples.zh: 我們公司在現場設有一間小診所給員工使用。

examples.en: Please call the clinic to book an appointment for next week.
examples.zh: 請打電話給診所預約下星期的門診。

similar.diff: hospital 規模較大，有急診和住院；clinic 較小，多處理一般門診。

example.en: The hospital has more beds and doctors than a small clinic.
example.zh: 醫院的病床和醫師比小診所多。

similar.diff: medical center 是較大的醫療機構，常結合門診、檢查與手術；clinic 規模較小。

example.en: The new medical center offers both checkups and surgery.
example.zh: 新的醫療中心同時提供健康檢查與手術。

example.en: The nurse took my temperature before the doctor arrived.
example.zh: 醫師到達前，護理師先量了我的體溫。

example.en: Each patient must fill out a form at the front desk.
example.zh: 每位病人都必須在櫃檯填一份表格。

example.en: I have an appointment with Dr. Lee at three.
example.zh: 我三點和李醫師有約診。

example.en: Employees get a free health checkup once a year.
example.zh: 員工每年可以做一次免費健康檢查。

derived.link: clinic + -al，變成形容詞「診所的、臨床的」，像 music → musical

senses.en: a small place where people get medical care

example.en: The clinic offers quick tests for common illnesses.
example.zh: 這間診所提供常見疾病的快速檢驗。

senses.en: a short class or event where people get help on one topic
senses.distinguish: 前面接 tax、business、coaching 這類非醫療的字時，指提供協助或指導的活動，不是診所。

example.en: The bank hosts a free tax clinic every April.
example.zh: 銀行每年四月舉辦免費的報稅諮詢活動。

extra_vocab.en: a person who collects things, or a person whose job is to collect money
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於藝術收藏、稅務與帳款催收情境，例如 art collector（藝術收藏家）、tax collector（稅務員）、debt collector（討債人員）。

example.en: Stamp collectors from many countries visited the trade fair.
example.zh: 來自許多國家的集郵者參觀了這場貿易展。

example.en: The famous art collector donated his paintings to the city.
example.zh: 這位有名的藝術收藏家把他的畫捐給了市政府。

example.en: A tax collector checked the company's records last week.
example.zh: 稅務員上星期檢查了公司的帳冊。

example.en: A debt collector sent a letter about the unpaid bill.
example.zh: 討債人員寄了一封關於未付帳單的信。

example.en: The ticket collector checked every passenger's ticket on the train.
example.zh: 查票員檢查了火車上每位乘客的車票。

examples.en: The museum borrowed several rare coins from a private collector.
examples.zh: 博物館向一位私人收藏家借了幾枚稀有的硬幣。

examples.en: The garbage collector comes to our street every Wednesday morning.
examples.zh: 垃圾收集員每星期三早上會來我們這條街。

examples.en: The company hired a collector to follow up on late payments.
examples.zh: 公司僱了一名收款人員來追蹤逾期的款項。

confusable.diff: collector 是「收集的人」；collection 是「收藏品」或「收集這件事」。

example.en: The museum opened a new collection of modern art.
example.zh: 博物館推出了一批新的現代藝術收藏。

example.en: The museum is open to visitors every day except Monday.
example.zh: 博物館除了星期一以外每天開放參觀。

example.en: The painting was sold at an auction for a high price.
example.zh: 這幅畫在拍賣會上以高價賣出。

example.en: The gallery will show works by local artists this month.
example.zh: 畫廊這個月會展出當地藝術家的作品。

example.en: The shop sells antiques from the early twentieth century.
example.zh: 這間店販售二十世紀初的古董。

derived.link: 最基礎的字。collector = collect + -or，做這件事的人，像 actor、visitor
collect + -ion，動詞變名詞，像 act → action
collect + -ive，變成形容詞「集體的」，像 act → active

senses.en: a person who collects things like art, stamps, or coins

example.en: The collector paid a high price for the old map.
example.zh: 這位收藏家花高價買下那張舊地圖。

senses.en: a person whose job is to collect money or things
senses.distinguish: 前面接 tax、debt、ticket、garbage 時，指負責收取的人員，不是收藏興趣。

example.en: The rent collector visits each apartment on the first of the month.
example.zh: 收租員在每月一號拜訪每一戶公寓。

extra_vocab.en: to collect information from different places and put it together
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於報告、統計、名單與資料整理情境，指把不同來源的資料整理成一份完整的文件。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 常用句型是 compile A from B（從 B 整理出 A），受詞多半是資料、清單或報告。

example.en: She compiles the weekly sales figures every Friday afternoon.
example.zh: 她每個星期五下午彙整每週的銷售數字。

example.en: The team compiled a list of all possible suppliers.
example.zh: 團隊整理出所有可能的供應商名單。

example.en: We are compiling the survey results for the board meeting.
example.zh: 我們正在整理董事會會議要用的調查結果。

example.en: Please compile a report on last quarter's expenses.
example.zh: 請彙整一份上一季開支的報告。

example.en: It took two days to compile data from all branches.
example.zh: 彙整所有分店的資料花了兩天。

example.en: I will compile a list of attendees by noon.
example.zh: 我會在中午前整理好出席者名單。

example.en: The agency compiles statistics on employment every month.
example.zh: 這個機構每個月編製就業統計資料。

examples.en: The assistant will compile the survey results into one file.
examples.zh: 助理會把調查結果彙整成一個檔案。

examples.en: Each team member must compile notes from their meetings.
examples.zh: 每位團隊成員必須整理自己的會議筆記。

examples.en: We compiled a guide of the best restaurants for clients.
examples.zh: 我們為客戶整理了一份最佳餐廳指南。

confusable.diff: comply 是「遵守（規定）」，拼法和 compile 很像，但意思完全不同。
confusable.usage: comply 後面要加 with（comply with the rules），compile 直接接受詞。

example.en: All staff must comply with the new safety rules.
example.zh: 所有員工都必須遵守新的安全規定。

similar.diff: gather 是把東西或資料集合起來；compile 還包含整理、編排成一份文件。

example.en: Please gather all receipts before you submit the claim.
example.zh: 提交請款前，請先把所有收據收集好。

similar.diff: 意思接近，較口語；compile 比較正式，常用於報告與資料。

example.en: Can you put together a short summary for the board?
example.zh: 你可以為董事會整理一份簡短摘要嗎？

example.en: The data shows a rise in online orders.
example.zh: 數據顯示網路訂單增加了。

example.en: These statistics come from a survey of five hundred companies.
example.zh: 這些統計資料來自對五百家公司的調查。

example.en: Please send me a short summary of the meeting.
example.zh: 請寄給我一份簡短的會議摘要。

example.en: Keep a record of every payment you make.
example.zh: 請保留你每一筆付款的紀錄。

derived.link: compile + -ation，動詞變名詞，像 educate → education

extra_vocab.zh: 冷藏箱、冷卻裝置、飲水機
extra_vocab.en: a container or machine that keeps things cold
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於戶外活動、餐飲運送與辦公室情境，例如放飲料的冷藏箱、辦公室的飲水機（water cooler）。這個拼法也是形容詞 cool 的比較級，意思是「更涼的」。

example.en: The caterer brought two large coolers filled with ice and drinks.
example.zh: 外燴業者帶來兩個裝滿冰塊和飲料的大冷藏箱。

example.en: Staff gathered around the water cooler to talk about the news.
example.zh: 員工聚在飲水機旁討論這則消息。

example.en: A portable cooler keeps the samples cold during transport.
example.zh: 攜帶式冷藏箱能讓樣品在運送途中保持低溫。

example.en: Pack the lunch in a cooler bag to keep it fresh.
example.zh: 把午餐放進保冷袋，才能保持新鮮。

examples.en: We put the drinks in a cooler before the picnic.
examples.zh: 野餐前，我們把飲料放進冷藏箱。

examples.en: A new water cooler was installed in the break room.
examples.zh: 休息室裝了一台新的飲水機。

examples.en: The fruit was shipped in a cooler to stay fresh.
examples.zh: 這些水果用冷藏箱運送，以保持新鮮。

confusable.diff: cooker 是「烹調用的爐具」，只差一個字母，但功能相反：cooler 是冷的，cooker 是熱的。

example.en: Please turn off the cooker before you leave the kitchen.
example.zh: 離開廚房前，請關掉爐具。

similar.diff: 意思接近，ice chest 是北美較口語的說法；cooler 較通用。

example.en: Put the fish in an ice chest to keep it cold.
example.zh: 把魚放進冰桶，保持低溫。

similar.diff: refrigerator 是固定在室內的冰箱；cooler 多半是可以搬動的保冷容器。

example.en: Store the milk in the refrigerator after opening it.
example.zh: 牛奶開封後請放在冰箱裡。

example.en: The ice cream must stay in the freezer overnight.
example.zh: 冰淇淋必須放在冷凍庫過夜。

example.en: Please bring enough ice for all the drinks.
example.zh: 請帶足夠的冰塊給所有飲料用。

example.en: Each guest will receive a bottle of cold water.
example.zh: 每位賓客都會拿到一瓶冰水。

derived.link: 最基礎的字。cooler = cool + -er，做冷卻工作的東西，像 heater（暖氣機）、printer（印表機）

example.en: Keep the vaccine in a cooler until the nurse arrives.
example.zh: 護理師到達前，請把疫苗放在冷藏箱裡。

example.en: The meeting room is cooler than the office downstairs.
example.zh: 會議室比樓下的辦公室更涼。

senses.en: a box that keeps food and drinks cold

example.en: Fill the cooler with ice before the guests arrive.
example.zh: 賓客到達前，請把冷藏箱裝滿冰塊。

senses.en: a machine that makes air or water cold
senses.distinguish: 前面接 water 或在辦公室出現時，通常指飲水機；也常借指大家聊天的地方。

example.en: The water cooler near the lobby needs a new filter.
example.zh: 大廳附近的飲水機需要換新的濾心。

extra_vocab.en: the part of the day when it is light
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於營業時間、班表、聯絡電話與天氣情境，例如 daytime hours、daytime phone number；當形容詞時放在名詞前，如 daytime job。

example.en: Our support line is open during daytime hours only.
example.zh: 我們的客服專線只在白天時段開放。

example.en: She kept her daytime job while she studied at night.
example.zh: 她晚上念書時，仍保留白天的工作。

example.en: Please give us a daytime phone number for delivery.
example.zh: 請提供我們一個白天可聯絡的電話，以便送貨。

example.en: The streets are very busy in the daytime.
example.zh: 街道在白天非常繁忙。

examples.en: The daytime shift starts at seven and ends at three.
examples.zh: 白班從七點開始，三點結束。

examples.en: Daytime temperatures in the desert can reach forty degrees.
examples.zh: 沙漠白天的氣溫可以高達四十度。

examples.en: Please call us during the daytime if you need help.
examples.zh: 如果需要協助，請在白天打電話給我們。

confusable.diff: daylight 是「日光、天亮的光線」；daytime 是「白天這段時間」。

example.en: We worked near the window to use natural daylight.
example.zh: 我們在窗邊工作，好利用自然日光。

confusable.diff: daily 是「每天的」，拼法開頭和 daytime 很像，但不是指白天。

example.en: The daily report is sent to the manager at five.
example.zh: 每日報告會在五點寄給經理。

example.en: Nighttime deliveries avoid heavy traffic in the city.
example.zh: 夜間配送可以避開市區的塞車。

example.en: The training session starts at six in the evening.
example.zh: 訓練課程在傍晚六點開始。

example.en: Who is working the night shift this week?
example.zh: 這個星期誰上夜班？

example.en: Our business hours are nine to six on weekdays.
example.zh: 我們平日的營業時間是九點到六點。

derived.link: 最基礎的字。daytime = day（白天）+ time（時間），白天的時段，像 lunchtime、bedtime
day 的 y 變成 i 再加 -ly，像 happy → happily
day + light（光），白天的光線，像 sunlight

example.en: The factory runs mostly in the daytime.
example.zh: 這間工廠主要在白天運作。

example.en: We offer daytime classes and evening classes for adults.
example.zh: 我們為成人提供日間班和夜間班。

extra_vocab.zh: 經銷商、汽車經銷店、經銷權
extra_vocab.en: a business that sells cars or other products for a larger company
extra_vocab.note: 多益最常見於汽車銷售與維修情境，例如 car dealership（汽車經銷店）、authorized dealership（授權經銷商）。

example.en: Several dealerships in the area offer special year-end discounts.
example.zh: 這個地區有幾間經銷店提供年終特價。

example.en: We bought our delivery van from a local car dealership.
example.zh: 我們的送貨車是向當地一間汽車經銷店買的。

example.en: Only an authorized dealership can repair this model under warranty.
example.zh: 只有授權經銷商才能在保固期內維修這款車。

example.en: She decided to open a dealership in her hometown.
example.zh: 她決定在家鄉開一間經銷店。

example.en: The brand has a large dealership network across Asia.
example.zh: 這個品牌在亞洲各地有龐大的經銷網絡。

examples.en: The car dealership offers free service for the first year.
examples.zh: 這間汽車經銷店提供第一年免費保養。

examples.en: He started working at a truck dealership after college.
examples.zh: 他大學畢業後開始在一間卡車經銷店工作。

examples.en: The company plans to open a new dealership downtown.
examples.zh: 公司計畫在市中心開一間新的經銷店。

confusable.diff: dealer 是賣東西的人或公司；dealership 是這家經銷店本身，或經銷的權利。

example.en: The dealer showed us three models that fit our budget.
example.zh: 經銷商向我們展示了三款符合預算的車型。

similar.diff: distributor 是把貨從廠商分送給零售店的經銷商；dealership 直接賣給消費者。

example.en: The distributor ships spare parts to every dealership each week.
example.zh: 經銷商每週把備用零件送到每一間經銷店。

example.en: The showroom displays all of our newest models.
example.zh: 展示間陳列了我們所有最新的車型。

example.en: The salesperson explained the features of each car.
example.zh: 銷售人員說明了每輛車的特色。

example.en: He owns a franchise of a well-known coffee chain.
example.zh: 他擁有一間知名連鎖咖啡店的加盟店。

example.en: The warranty covers repairs for the first three years.
example.zh: 保固涵蓋前三年的維修。

derived.link: 最基礎的字。dealer = deal + -er（做這件事的人），dealership 再加 -ship

senses.en: a business that sells cars or other products for a maker

example.en: The dealership sold forty cars during the weekend sale.
example.zh: 這間經銷店在週末特賣期間賣出四十輛車。

senses.en: the right to sell a company's products in a place
senses.distinguish: 和 give、win、hold 等動詞一起用時，指獲得或擁有銷售的權利，不是一間店。

example.en: The company gave him the dealership for the northern region.
example.zh: 公司把北部地區的經銷權給了他。

extra_vocab.zh: 甲板、露臺、簡報、（交通工具的）層
extra_vocab.en: a flat surface or level, such as on a ship, outside a house, or in a presentation
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見四種用法：船的甲板（on deck）、戶外木平台或露臺、公車與渡輪的樓層（upper deck），以及一份簡報檔（slide deck）。要靠上下文判斷意思。

example.en: Both decks of the ferry were crowded with tourists.
example.zh: 渡輪的兩層甲板都擠滿了遊客。

example.en: Please send me the slide deck before the meeting.
example.zh: 請在會議前把簡報檔寄給我。

example.en: The captain asked all crew members to be on deck.
example.zh: 船長要求所有船員到甲板上集合。

example.en: The upper deck of the bus offers a great view.
example.zh: 巴士的上層視野很棒。

example.en: The observation deck is open until ten at night.
example.zh: 觀景台開放到晚上十點。

examples.en: Passengers can relax on the sun deck after lunch.
examples.zh: 午餐後，乘客可以在日光甲板上放鬆。

examples.en: She updated the deck with the latest sales figures.
examples.zh: 她用最新的銷售數字更新了簡報。

examples.en: The restaurant has a wooden deck beside the river.
examples.zh: 這間餐廳在河邊有一座木頭露臺。

confusable.diff: desk 是「辦公桌」，拼法只差一個字母，但意思完全不同。

example.en: Please leave the files on my desk before you go.
example.zh: 你離開前，請把文件放在我的桌上。

similar.diff: presentation 是整場報告或簡報；deck 只指簡報用的投影片檔案。

example.en: Her presentation was clear and short, so everyone enjoyed it.
example.zh: 她的簡報清楚又簡短，所以大家都很喜歡。

similar.diff: slides 是一張一張的投影片；deck 是整份投影片的集合。

example.en: I printed the slides for everyone in the meeting.
example.zh: 我把投影片印出來給會議上的每個人。

example.en: The ferry leaves the harbor every hour on weekends.
example.zh: 週末渡輪每小時從港口出發。

example.en: The company arranged a cruise for its top sellers.
example.zh: 公司為業績最好的銷售人員安排了一趟郵輪旅行。

example.en: Each room has a private balcony facing the sea.
example.zh: 每間房都有面海的私人陽台。

example.en: We held the meeting outside on the patio.
example.zh: 我們在戶外的露天庭院開會。

senses.en: the flat top level of a ship

example.en: Passengers gathered on deck to watch the ship leave the port.
example.zh: 乘客聚集在甲板上，看著船離開港口。

senses.en: a flat wooden area outside a building
senses.distinguish: 和 wooden、garden、pool、restaurant 等字一起出現時，指戶外的木平台。

example.en: Guests can enjoy dinner on the deck overlooking the lake.
example.zh: 賓客可以在俯瞰湖面的露臺上用晚餐。

senses.en: a set of slides used in a business presentation
senses.distinguish: 和 slide、pitch、investor 等字一起出現時，指一整份簡報檔。

example.en: The sales deck includes charts for the last three quarters.
example.zh: 這份業務簡報包含過去三季的圖表。

senses.en: one level of a bus, ship, or other large vehicle
senses.distinguish: 前面接 upper、lower、car 或 bus 時，指車船的某一層。

example.en: Cars are parked on the lower deck of the ferry.
example.zh: 車輛停放在渡輪的下層。

extra_vocab.en: having a very good taste or smell
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於餐廳、飯店、活動餐點與廣告情境，用來稱讚食物，語氣比 good 更強、很正面。

example.en: The hotel served a delicious meal after the conference.
example.zh: 會議結束後，飯店供應了一頓美味的餐點。

example.en: These cookies taste delicious and are made without sugar.
example.zh: 這些餅乾嚐起來很美味，而且不含糖。

example.en: Visitors enjoy the delicious food at the night market.
example.zh: 遊客很喜歡夜市裡的美味食物。

example.en: All the desserts on the table look delicious.
example.zh: 桌上所有的甜點看起來都很好吃。

examples.en: The soup was so delicious that we ordered a second bowl.
examples.zh: 這碗湯太好喝了，所以我們又點了第二碗。

examples.en: The caterer prepared a delicious lunch for all the guests.
examples.zh: 外燴業者為所有賓客準備了美味的午餐。

examples.en: Try our delicious new sandwich for only five dollars.
examples.zh: 試試我們美味的新三明治，只要五美元。

confusable.diff: delightful 是「令人愉快的」，可形容活動、人或地方；delicious 專指食物好吃。

example.en: It was a delightful evening with our new business partners.
example.zh: 和我們的新商業夥伴共度了愉快的一晚。

confusable.diff: delicate 是「精緻的、易碎的」，拼法開頭和 delicious 很像，但和味道無關。

example.en: The delicate glass cups must be packed with care.
example.zh: 這些精緻的玻璃杯必須小心包裝。

similar.diff: tasty 是「好吃的」，語氣比較口語、程度較輕；delicious 的稱讚更強烈。

example.en: The tasty snacks at the party disappeared within ten minutes.
example.zh: 派對上好吃的點心不到十分鐘就被吃光了。

example.en: This ice cream comes in twelve different flavors.
example.zh: 這款冰淇淋有十二種不同口味。

example.en: The chef shared his recipe with the magazine.
example.zh: 主廚把他的食譜分享給雜誌。

example.en: We use fresh fruit in every dessert.
example.zh: 我們每一道甜點都使用新鮮水果。

example.en: The chef created a special menu for the event.
example.zh: 主廚為這場活動設計了特別菜單。

derived.link: delicious + -ly，形容詞變副詞，像 quick → quickly
delicious + -ness，把性質變成名詞，像 kind → kindness
